profile.name: 液位传感器
profile.description: 用于检测容器、储液槽或流体处理系统中液体液位的实验室设备，可用于监测试剂余量、避免吸空或溢出，并支持自动化流体处理过程中的液位确认。
profile.description_en: A laboratory device used to detect the liquid level in containers, reservoirs, or fluid-handling systems. It is used to monitor reagent volume, prevent running dry or overflow, and confirm liquid presence in automated fluid-handling workflows.
